openaq.status: not used — https://api.openaq.org/v3 returns HTTP 401 without an API key

_meta.method: calibrated[m] = CAMS[m] * WHO_annual / mean(CAMS). WHO settlement matched in the same country within 10 km of the city point (or 25 km with a name-prefix match, 80 km with an exact name match); WHO annual = mean of the latest up-to-3 reported years >= 2018. Note the year mismatch (WHO 2018-2025 vs CAMS 2022-09-01..2026-08-31). Overrides from data/air-overrides.json are applied last.
